high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from a news article on CNN's website, dated June 12, 2023. The headline reads, "See Venetians protest Jeff Bezos' wedding," indicating that the article discusses protests in Venice, Italy, against the upcoming wedding of billionaire Jeff Bezos and journalist Lauren Sanchez. Main Image (Top Left): The image shows a helicopter flying over St. Mark's Square in Venice, Italy. The helicopter has a banner attached to it with the word "BEZOS" written on it.
